verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs confirm iterative follow-up prompting is supported ('send a follow-up, a correction, or a new idea at any time to steer the work') and Build mode executes changes end-to-end, but there is no explicit evidence that these edits preserve prior functionality. Community reports of code quality issues, unwieldy single-file structures, and abandoned/broken prototypes suggest iteration can degrade a project as complexity grows.
